◈ "UNIT WEDDING RING — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Wedding Ring
Gold band, worn thin. Inside: initials and a date. You remember the day — the rain, the borrowed suit, the laughter during the vows. Grief is just love with nowhere to go.

◈ "UNIT DISPATCHER'S HEADSET — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; calm under pressure. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Dispatcher's headset
You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts.

◈ "UNIT UNNAMED PHOTOGRAPH — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Unnamed photograph
There is a name you won't say out loud anymore. The photo doesn't need you to say it. Somebody you loved didn't make it to the clearing, and this is what's left of the proof they were here.

◈ "UNIT MIXTAPE — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Mixtape
Hand-labeled: 'FOR THE DRIVE.' No player. The songs are in your head anyway — you hum them when you work, and the work goes faster.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Thornfield bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Assimilated. The overlay feels like home. That should probably worry you.
